question: what happens if i never pay my parking ticket
expected_answer: After 60 days the citation goes to a collection agency with extra collection fees, and a balance older than 120 days gets a State of Texas hold. Three or more unpaid citations, fines over $160, or any balance older than 90 days can also get your vehicle booted or towed.

* **Booting or Towing:** If you have three or more unpaid citations, fines exceeding $160.00, or any citation balance older than 90 days, your vehicle may be booted, towed, and impounded at your expense (https://transport.tamu.edu/Parking/regulations.aspx).
* **Collection Agency Fees:** Citations left unpaid for longer than 60 days are turned over to a third-party collection agency, and additional collection fees will be added to your balance (https://transport.tamu.edu/Parking/regulations.aspx).
* **State Hold:** A State Hold (alert) will be issued to the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts for customers with an outstanding citation balance older than 120 days until the unpaid balance and collection fees are paid in full (https://transport.tamu.edu/Parking/regulations.aspx).

question: how do i get my laptop, xbox and tv all online in my room at the commons
expected_answer: Use TAMU WiFi for the laptop, and the TAMU_IoT network or a wired ResNet (Ethernet) connection for the Xbox and TV. To connect more than one wired device, bring a router with its wireless signal turned off. Unapproved network devices are prohibited in residence halls.

* **Xbox and Smart TV:** Gaming consoles and smart TVs cannot log in directly to standard campus Wi-Fi, so you must connect them to the **TAMU_IoT** wireless network.
